name: Panera Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast on Country Rustic Sourdough (Plain)
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced, tender roasted turkey breast on naturally fermented Country Rustic Sourdough bread with light mayonnaise. Naturally low in fructans due to sourdough fermentation, low in fiber, and delivers 30g+ of lean poultry protein without spices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Roasted Turkey & Avocado BLT—MODIFIED: On Country Rustic Sourdough, NO bacon, NO lettuce, NO tomato, NO red onion, with light mayo.' Or build a custom plain turkey sandwich.
